title.narrative: Access to productive employment, decent work and income opportunities for women and men facilitated.

description.narrative: Following the adoption the DWCP (2023-2025) by Somalia, the ILO supported the Ministry of Labour and the social partners to develop a “National employment programme”. The programme document is meant to operationalize the National Employment Policy (2019) and raise DC resources for its implementation. The CPO SOM101 is thus aimed at putting in place the necessary institutional structures and undertake sector specific interventions to operationalize the national employment programme. The interventions in this respect include capacity building of key institutional and socio-economic assistance that will support employment promotion as well as support the peace building effort in Somalia. The CPO also intends to supporting local authorities through the KfW funded EIIP project in Baidoa that is aimed at enhancing the capacities of local governments for the delivery of infrastructure services, including the promotion of adoption of labour-based technologies thus ensuring immediate job opportunities for internal displaced persons and the host communities. In addition, through the Better regional migration management (BRMM) Project, the CPO also aims at enhancing labour migration governance in Somalia. This will be achieved through strategic support to strengthening the capacity of government and social partners, development of evidence-based policies, enhance migrant workers’ qualifications and skills, and actively engage the social partners in all the processes.
